reviews.text: Like most veterinary practices I’ve encountered in the New York metro area, this business preys on the understandably close connection most people have with their pets by presenting them with diagnostic and treatment options that extend far beyond what’s recommended as industry-standard as if they’re bare minimum, overcharging for all of them, and making you feel cheap/inadequate/cruel for not moving forward with them. I don’t want to speak poorly of the staff of BVC because I’m not sure how much power they have to change any of the problems I’m describing here, but the ownership should be ashamed.

I've been taking my cats here for 4 years and only had good experiences with my annual checkups. During the appointments, the team is professional and caring.

However, the clinic does not accommodate sick visits. When my cat became sick and needed a checkup and antibiotics ASAP, they could only offer an appt that was 2 weeks away. It's disappointing, and I think a vet clinic should allow space for emergency walk-ins daily, or at least work with an ongoing client to find a 15 minute slot to see a sick pet in the next 1-3 days. At minimum write down my number and offer to call if any cancellations occur.

I know this one review is not going to change that, but I really wish they would take it to heart, because truly, it just hurts to feel so uncared for.

These guys really dropped the ball on a medical emergency. The attitude of the staff was that they really didn't care or try to fix the issue.

This all. took place while trying to treat a life-threatening diagnosis. They didn't have enough of the prescription my dog needed which is understandable, but they did nothing to ensure I had enough of the medication for the entire treatment, and no one communicated properly with me. They gave me the rest of what they had which would only last a couple days and told me they ordered the rest through Chewy which was supposed to show up in the mail, and that they ordered some for themselves too. Neither happened and I am left without medication, so my dog ran out of antibiotics for a life threatening issue in the middle of the treatment plan. Also three times during the process of treatment they said someone would call me back and they didn't. If I wasn't proactive and constantly following up my dog could have died.

Doctors are nice when you finally get them on the phone or in person but the office is run so poorly that my dogs life was put at risk. I would never recommend this place.

Huey is six years old, and like so many dog owners, I can honestly say he is my whole world. It’s just the two of us, so everything that matters most to me somehow comes back to him.
Dr. Ona is new at Bushwick Veterinary Center, and I have to say I am absolutely thrilled that we met her. Huey is a big dog, a pit bull/Lab mix, and he is reactive and very protective of his mom. Dr. Ona was wonderful with him from the very beginning. There was no high-pitched baby talk, no overwhelming him, no rushing. She was calm, kind, patient, and completely respectful of who he is.
At one point all of us, including the technician, were down on the floor with Huey, examining him and letting him feel as comfortable as possible. Dr. Ona noticed things right away that I had planned to ask about later, including a lipoma and a small new growth near his eye. She took her time with every single question I had — his weight, his diet, the growths, the lipoma, his overall health — and explained everything clearly and patiently. I never felt rushed. I never felt like I was asking too much. That meant so much to me.
I also want to mention Sydney, the technician, if I remember her name correctly. Huey needed blood drawn and two vaccines, and the blood draw was not easy. It took several people to help keep him calm and comfortable, and at one point, while we were all on the floor with him, I noticed Sydney gently kissing his fur and comforting him while they were trying to get the blood sample.
That moment has stayed with me. Sydney, please never change that part of yourself. To care enough to comfort someone else’s frightened dog like that, simply because you want him to feel safe, is something incredibly special. I was genuinely moved, and I am still grateful for it.
For someone like me, whose dog is truly family and the most important part of my life, veterinary visits can be stressful and emotional. This visit was different. It was patient, compassionate, gentle, and full of genuine care.
I feel incredibly lucky to have Bushwick Veterinary Center within walking distance of my home, and even luckier that it has turned out to be such a wonderful clinic for a dog who needs a little extra patience and understanding.
Thank you, Dr. Ona, Sydney, and the entire team for treating Huey with so much kindness. I will remember it for a very long time.

I have been coming to this Vet for years with 3 dogs. I've never had an issue with them till now. Im leaving to Mexico and called earlier in the month 2 times for an appointment for a health certificate to take my little one but the incompetent receptionist told me I could use the one I had done a month and a half ago. This did not sit well with me so I called again today to make an appointment just to update the health certificate. I got squeezed in and when I got there I was charged 285 due to a walk in fee. I explained to the receptionist the nurse and the doctor that I should not be penalized for a mistake they made. They did not care and stated they gave me a discount which was not true. Because I had the same paperwork done plus rabies shot and paid less than what I got charged. I will never step into this clinic again. They make mistakes and I showed them proof I called and nothing. Im so pissed off. They do not take accountability for the errors they make. I gave them one star because that was the lowest I could go. But I feel like I got robbed in public.
Best vet ive ever had.  6/5 stars at least
They never call back

Am so happy my Charlie found the best Veterinay whose team is so effective, efficient, and is equipped for any visit or needs for my beloved Jack Russell, I received the best service and recommend advice from weight watch, teeth chews to best food choices, I look forward to our relationship and am very happy it’s so close to walking distance, also great team!! Awesome 🌹🌹🌹

Thank you Dr Thai for taking care of me on my first visit with you. My name is pumpkin. I am a tiger and orange kitty. You told Mom everything she needed to know on how to care for me. You treated me with kitten gloves, but the truth is, I have the kitten gloves. I look forward to seeing you again. I have some more work to be done and I only wanna be with you meow, meow, meow all the Services and all the people there helped me all the time. Thank you, Dr. Ty.🥰🥰🥰🥰

My kitty is incredibly fearful of the vet and we had a wonderful experience here! They talk you through everything, spend dedicated time with you and provide concrete pricing so you can make the best decision for your pets. Plus, they are just animal people. Dr Morten is the best. Cat whisperer!

This practice is incredibly negligent. Do not take your animals here. We are never coming back.

We asked for them to remove a small mat by our double coated dog's prepuce and somehow they returned him to us with the fur on his butt (completely different area) shaved to the skin and didn't tell us they did this. It's incredibly common knowledge that you should never shave a double coated dog's fur unless medically necessary.

They also try to push as many expensive and unnecessary diagnostic tests as they can to siphon your wallet. They also add extra items to your bill without discussing it with you beforehand, only for you to discover it with the vet tech while reviewing charges so you can't ask the actual vet about those extra charges.

I was traveling from Los Angeles through New York to go to England with my dog. I had to have the tapeworm done within five days before boarding my cruise ship with my dog. I had called Bushwick veterinary center from Los Angeles And set up an appointment. The people at Bushwick veterinary Center were the most caring and loving of every animal I saw in there. The service was great. They explained everything to me how I needed to proceed. And I don’t know if I’ve ever been to a veterinary clinic That were this nice and caring. I would recommend Bushwick veterinary center to anyone.JM
Good

I took my dog for some vaccine updates and yearly checkup, nothing much. She came home and had a squinty eye.

I took her back the next day and the vet prescribed me an ointment. Her eye pressure was never measured despite the squinting and as a result, after days of pure pain (and vomiting from so much pain) I took dog to VERG (it was Sunday) as she looked like she was dying. They said her eye pressure was nearly 50 - it had killed her vision over the past few days and given her excruciating pain to the point she couldn’t fall asleep or walk or nothing.

We were told that the eye could have been saved had we measured its pressure and given the correct care. But Bushwick Veterinary Center never considered measuring the eye pressure and that blinded my dog. She had an enucleation (eye completely removed from face and eye lids sewn together), a trauma that would have been avoided if the eye pressure was measured and dealt with when I took her there. How could they send the dog home without testing for high risk things nor recommending a specialist.

We had no idea it could be so serious as to take her eye like this. And I go to vet professionals for such information.

Dr. Tai took care of Ruth’s cancer and we wanted to bring her back for checkups and aspirations but it has been hard to trust any vet again. So scary.

They provide more services like custom allergy shots but the time it takes to get service after check-in is increasingly delayed. More professionalism is needed by the staff - they sometimes seem to be getting too comfortable, and will sit on the floor during vital check-ups as if it’s their living room.

Front desk has consistently maintained professionalism.

very happy to be able to take my cat, max for bloodwork and a check up at bushwick veterinary center. very clean and quiet environment. professional and friendly staff they were very patient and helped me to understand how to care for her. particular shout out to sydney, dr. taie , sarah and jessica!  tysm!

I had to put my dog down due to her cancer getting really bad.  I chose this Vet after trying to reach a vet that was impossible to get on the phone. Nobody picked up so I contacted Bushwick Veterinary Center instead.  They were very kind and compassionate and understanding of my tough emotional situation and handled my Bella's transition with care and love and attention that is rare nowadays.  If I have another pet in the future this will be my only vet I will trust as long as I live here in Brooklyn.  I want to thank them for being so kind and caring and understanding.  Even though I am going thru a bad experience emotionally their vet care was a very good experience despite the fact I was there to euthanize my baby Bella.  Bella Rest easy, the pain is over and I will always have you in my thoughts and my heart! Thans Bushwick Veterinary !

My dog Monty received the best care here up until the end of his life. They even made the worst day of my life as comfortable as possible and were so gentle with him. The staff was beyond kind and knowledgeable and loved on him so much. They truly are angels. It made him actually love going to the vet. They worked with me several times on budgeting for his care. I cannot recommend them enough.
Super nice staff! It took about an hour for a wellness exam for biggie. I left with my concerns addressed, I will be returning. Thank you!

The best vet!! The staff is kind and efficient and empathetic. I needed a last minute vaccine for some work travel and they fit me in the same day. They are extremely responsive through email and phone and truly care about your pet!

I’ve been bringing my dog Mia here for years, and I can’t say enough great things about this clinic. Everyone is incredibly kind, compassionate, and truly cares. They always remember Mia and treat her like their own. The level of effort they put into helping us honestly meant so much and even made me emotional. As someone who trains dogs, having more time with my own means everything, and I’m so grateful for the care they’ve given her. Thank you to Bri, the doctors, the surgical team, the nurses, and the entire staff. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for genuine, compassionate care.

I brought my bird Coco in for an injured leg and the team was incredibly kind and attentive from start to finish. They were very reasonable with pricing, which I truly appreciated.The wait time was a bit longer than expected but honestly, I’d much rather have a vet who takes their time and is thorough than one who rushes through appointments. It showed that they genuinely care about each animal they see. The staff took great care of Coco and made sure I understood everything that was going on. They walked me through the treatment plan and answered all my questions. Will continue to go to them :)

I am new to the area and I realized my babygirl had an ear infection. I called another vet and they told me it would be a month before I could get her seen. I made a call to BVC and they got me in the next day! From the time I entered the facility, everyone was so nice and welcoming. The vet tech was amazing. So caring and comforting to my baby girl who was so scared. The vet saw her and again was very informative and did a through exam. They sent me home with ear drops and instructions. Definitely will be returning and bring both my cats here! Thank you so much for caring and making us feel comfortable!

Lily and I had an amazing experience here. We had a previous horrible experience at our last vet that really deteriorated our experiences with vets and was nervous about finding a new one. But we’re so happy we found Bushwick vet center. Not only is this walking distance from our home, the staff is amazing. The front staff to vet tech to vet doctor.

They started us off in a room with the vet tech and she went eye level with Lily which I loved. Made her feel comfortable and allowed me to be a part of everything. Even when the doctor came in and did the exam, they allowed me to pet Lily’s head and relax her which they never allowed me to do at my old vet.

They were transparent about the exam, anything that was going to happen, and the final bill. Nothing was a surprise. I also love how they offered me to be in the room when drawing Lily’s blood and shots.

We’re very happy with our switch!

I feel SO lucky to live walking distance from this wonderful vet. All of the vet techs I have worked with and doctors here have all been so kind. I never feel rushed, and all of my questions get answered.

The reception staff are not helpful or understanding, they don’t seem to care about you or your pet. Getting answers to my questions over the phone is always difficult, and it feels like they want to do as little as possible in order to get you to hang up. I unfortunately have to go here because my other vet is too far, and the doctors seem okay, but the reception staff are not. I had to ask so many questions when paying a $130 deposit for an appointment about the deposit policy just to get an answer that is wrong. Then I get a text two days later with the real deposit policy, which is different than what I was told over the phone. I don’t understand what the point of having reception staff is if they can’t answer basic questions about the cancellation policy here. And when I asked about this mistake, they still told me that I would lose my deposit if I tried to reschedule my appointment, when their own staff told me otherwise. I don’t think it’s right or fair.

I brought my 16 year old dog in to get a refill for apoquel since they wouldn’t do it over the phone.   My appointment was on Dec 31 at 5pm.    I was sitting in the waiting room till 5:45. When i was brought to the exam room with my dog an assistant asked why we are there.  I mentioned for a refill.   She asked some questions then said the vet will be in shortly.   At 6:30 I’m still in the exam room with my dog and daughter.    I asked the assistant what is going on?  She said she would find out.   She didn’t come back.  10 minutes later I asked again.   I couldn’t understand why I had to wait for the vet to give a refill.  I asked this question.   I said, “am I waiting for the vet to look at my dog, pet her head then he will refill the script?”  Assistant said the vet needs to give his exam for this medication.    Finally at almost 6:50(!!!) the vet comes in.   He apologized.   I said I would like you to do whatever you minimally need to do in order for me to get the refill so I can leave.   He listened to her heart with a stethoscope, looked in her ears, petted the dog then said, “okay, I will give you a refill now.”    I was shocked at the nonsense I was just put through ON NEW YEARS EVE!.  Finally walked out at 7:00.   They waived the office fee.

Bushwick Vet has been so good to me and my pet. I really trust them with my chronically ill Pomeranian, and Dr. Taie has always been so attentive and caring with her. Navigating scary symptoms and diagnoses is truly made better by people who actually care about your pet's well being. From the secretaries to the techs, I am truly grateful for all of the help and support over the years. These folks truly love animals!
really kind people. i brought in an injured street rat to be euthanized and they treated it with love and care just like any other pet, even talked me through the different options
My local vet and always lovely and priced well
I am completely satisfied with the care my puppy receives at this office. All employees are kind and respectful.
I had a great experience with the vet techs and the vet, they were all amazing and friendly and my dog who is usually nervous around new places also loved his visit!
Best pet care!!

The team at Bushwick Veterinary Center is the BEST. Every time we come in, we are treated like family from the reception desk, to the vet techs, to the vets themselves. The vets spend so much time listening to our concerns and providing helpful plans of care. We have always felt so supported and that the best interest of our pets was at the forefront. We are so grateful for everyone's kindness and care. (Dogs)
Well priced, nice staff, speedy service

Much appreciation to all the wonderful staff who were there when we had to put down our beloved cat. They stayed far past closing to ensure we had all the time we needed with her. Their compassion and gestures were touching.

the staff has been awesome with both of my cats! fergus saw dr. bogie and she addressed my concerns with care and tended to my very anxious cat so kindly. the staff said he was a perfect angel and they definitely made it easier on him :)

PROS:
- much needed affordable vet care in the area
- usually have same day or next day appts available
- quality of care is mostly solid depending on the vet you see

CONS:
- slow, often waiting before/after appointments for 30min-1hour
- the medicine approval when ordering from chewy is extremely slow and seems to have some sort of disconnect between the approvals and the vet notes from the visit? Waited over a week for them to approve a medication for my foster cat that they told me to order from Chewy because they didn't have it in stock. I called daily to remind them to approve it, only for them to reject the prescription after a full week of it sitting in the queue. After calling for the fifth time they realized it was a mistake but I had to put in a whole new order & wait for them to approve again and then have it ship before we got our meds - at this time it had been two full weeks since the vet visit before I was able to start administering the medicine, all because they couldn't get it together to approve it even though they prescribed it in the first place during our visit. A lot of time wasted for no reason.

Hello everyone, I visited this place approximately twice. My dog ​​was a
who was approximately four months old. I had a very bad experience with the reception area of ​​this place. They are people who only understand you in one language, English. So, I advise you that if you do not speak English, do not come to this place, since the reception area is totally racist and will not assist you. Aside from that, they will cut off your calls and will not care that you are just another patient and that your pet needs to see a doctor. I really do not understand how they have that type of staff working in a place that is for patients, very little professional ethics with people, it is always better to hire a person who speaks two languages ​​for this type of thing, since it is an animal clinic, we live in a city where there are multinationals and I believe that with respect to each language, it should be attended to, so I do not advise you to visit this place because of that. The health staff, doctors and nurses are very good, but the reception area is totally terrible, you will get a very bad shock.!!!
The service is very good.

Overall really solid vet! Usually very quick wait times, appointments are open, and I feel the techs really care for animals. Sometimes I do feel like an extra test is ordered than we need and I tend to turn some down. This doesn’t deter me from taking my pet here however!

The staff are incredibly welcoming and friendly towards pets, accommodate to your needs, and make their services affordable if needed. I’ve had my dog vaccinated and treated with upmost care, plus they answered all my over the top questions with understanding and compassion. I definitely recommend a visit even if you hadn’t taken your pup to the vet for a while, they’re very clear with their services/communication!!
Wonderful place with an amazing and compassionate team that truly cares about animals. Thank you to Dr. Ayas and Bri for taking great care of my pup!

Genuinely the most compassionate and caring vet practice I’ve ever been to! They saw my boy on a moment’s notice because I was so worried and treated both of us with such kindness and care! They eased my concerns and I really don’t know what I would have done without them, I’m so grateful! I will always trust them with my dog! ❤️

Always the best pet care and service. They treat my cats with care and gentleness. I had to put down my senior cat who was under Dr. Thaie care and he was really gentle and careful with my cat, and me!  He walked me through the entire process which is pretty hard to navigate with a broken heart. I will be forever grateful to him. Now, my younger cats are under the care of Dr. Grossman and since they’re young they just go in for checkups and it’s easy, on time and hassle free. They email all info and if medication is needed they either give it to you the day of the consultation or set up a delivery through chewy. All I had to do was pay and wait for the delivery to arrive.
I will always bring my pets there!!!
I'm so grateful for the care my dog ​​receives. They're always so kind, even when they're very busy. Thank you all!

Has been my loval vet for years, have always had issues but their new deposit system is the last straw, no rolling deposit when needing to reschedule an appointment due to emergency. In addition to that, one of the main vets here consistently talked down to me and insisted that my cat was overgrooming due to fleas (for several months) when she did not in fact have any fleas and I gave her unnecessary flea treatments to  prove my point and he insisted that I just wasn't doing a good enough job getting rid of the fleas. Took her to another vet and of course they agreed she did not have fleas but had developed allergies in her old age. This vet used to be an affordable local option but in recent years, even that is no linger true and now they will charge you a deposit for absolutely no reason and keep it if you need to reschedule and charge you a whole new one. Predatory practices, the front desk staff is always disinterested and seems as if you are wasting their time by just talking to them. The only good part about this vet is the techs. They are always lovely.

This clinic violated my privacy by sharing my personal information with a third-party cat adoption agency without my consent — a clear breach of trust and client confidentiality. I never authorized any contact, yet they leaked my info and then refused to respond to repeated calls and emails when I confronted them.

If they can’t handle basic ethics or respect for their clients, how can you trust them with your pet’s care? I’ve filed complaints with the NY Attorney General, the NYS Veterinary Board, and the FTC.

Shameful behavior, zero accountability, and complete disregard for client rights. Avoid.

Pretty unsanitary and not up-kept with the maintenance. No trash can for disposable cups (which doesnt make sense), no cup to feed your dog water, no treats but crumbs left in the jar, and finally, a dirty couch.
Someone needs to tidy up the area.

Vets themselves are friendly and professional, although sometimes they push for upselling.

I had to put down my poor Princess after she got cancer. And though my heart was crushed beyond anything imaginable, coming here helped my family take the first steps in healing. The staff here i can't praise enough. Iam so very thankful for their kindness and generosity towards us. I adopted a new dog because the shelters are so full and I was so lonely. This will be our forever vet. There's so much more I could say, but just know you can be confident coming here and getting the best care.

I visited here back in February or so, to get my dog's anal gland expressed and checked out. Not only did I get talked over and basically mansplained to by the vet, but picking up medications like a week after sucked. The techs took 30 minutes to even find my meds (in a unlocked top cabinet between the front doors, btw), and just seemed overall annoyed that I was even there in the first place. Just a generally unpleasant experience.
Fantastic vet, they made my cat feel safe by giving her a bunch of churus. We took her to get dental work done and the procedure and recover went very smoothly

I wouldn't trust these people with a stuffed animal. Revolving door of incompetent vets who feel more like salespeople than knowledgeable medical professionals. For example, a month ago I called because my dog was limping on his right leg. One of the doctors told me he probably had a torn ligament and would need surgery, and I needed to come in for x-rays right away. She immediately jumped to surgery without even seeing the dog. Absolutely insane. Thankfully, I opted to wait a few days, and his leg healed on its own.

One of the doctors told me my dog had muscle loss around his skull, and that it was probably a degenerative disease that would seal his mouth shut if I didn't act immediately. I shelled out $400+ for the test, and a few weeks later the doctor calls me to tell me the test is inconclusive, likely positive, and referred me to a specialist. When I went to the specialist, she told me the test was negative, and she wasn't sure why they referred me to her. Another time, I went in for a routine check-up and the doctor aggressively tried to sell me an elective surgery to remove his dewclaws.

Last week, I went in because my dog's left eye had been sunken. The doctor looked at his eye and told me she thinks he has a brain tumor and I should shell out $$$ for x-rays. You can't diagnose a brain tumor with x-rays, you need an MRI, so I'm unsure what purpose $500 worth of x-rays would have served. Again, she immediately jumped to the worst possible outcome to try to scare me into buying x-rays that I don't need. I really didn't trust that she had any idea what she was talking about, so I declined and opted to take him to an eye specialist.

I've been coming to this vet for five years and have never seen the same doctor twice, which I think speaks volumes about the practice. These last few experiences really turned me off, and I will not be going back again.

I took my dog, Fang, here since he was a puppy. When Dr. T was the only vet, he was thorough and always kind to Fang. Once additional doctors came in, the level of care drastically changed. Last year, we took Fang to the Bushwick Vet over bladder issues he was having multiple times with no answers and more tests needing to be done (sometimes just repeating the same tests for whatever reason with the same results that told us nothing). There was no communication between the vets on best course of actions and one of the doctors just kept dismissing our concerns. Fang ended up having a rare prostate cancer and it was too late by the time he was diagnosed by a doctor we saw in Park Slope. I’m not one to ask “what if”, but I do believe if they had communicated with each otherand not just performing the same tests on him/dismissing him, we may have had a fighting chance. Once we got confirmation of his cancer and called to let Bushwick Vet know + ask for advice, they hadn’t called us back or checked in with us at all. Fang sadly passed away in September and the vet he’s seen since he was a puppy truly let us down.

*Editing to say that the front desk staff has always been kind and helpful. I don’t think it should fall on them on how much this vet center let us down.
Only one experience to base review on but it was clean, quiet, friendly and efficient for our cat. Convenient location too.
I had a great experience bringing my dog here. Everyone was super nice to me and my dog. Besides very friendly, all the staff communicated very well!
they always make costs clear prior to service so nothing unexpected, very clear communication with office and accessible to make appointments with
I have been going here for 2 years now and I would highly recommend! The staff is very friendly and the pricing is reasonable for NYC!
The front desk workers are rude and a bit unprofessional. This was my second time using this vet office as I’m new to bushwick and they don’t provide good customer service.

The veterinarians are great with my anxious little rescue, and the staff is generally great when it comes to requesting refills for his meds. But over the Christmas through New Years holidays, I called and left messages trying to get a refill and no one got back to me until after new years, at which point my little guy had gone several days without his nightly psych meds and the consequential detriment to his mental health was very apparent. I just wish that communication around holiday hours and availability would have been better communicated so that we could have been better prepared and not missed several days of our dog’s Prozac.
Great staff and service

I'm a first time dog owner and was looking for a neighborhood vet. There were all sorts of options in North Brooklyn, but Bushwick Vet was highly recommended by other pet owners and I see why. Setting up my appointment was easy. The folks at the front desk were proactive in confirming dates and requesting documents. Once I got there with my pup, the place was clean and nice. The vet staff were knowledgeable and expertly handled my pup during her examination. The follow up was great too. It turned out my pup had a parasite and needed some medication. The staff answered all my questions and made treatment super simple. Overall, if you're looking for a long-term vet for your pet, this is a great place to do so. 5 stars!

If I can give them 10stars of course... I will!!
I'm so impressed with this place! The vets are incredibly skilled and efficient. They quickly diagnosed my pet's condition and provided excellent treatment. The staff is friendly and the clinic is always clean and organized.
We brought my cat in urgently last week and the staff and vet could not have been more kind. My cat is still mad about the collar, but it’s helping. :-)
While I am grateful to the front desk staff and the vet techs for their help with seeing my cat day-of, I felt that Dr. Tai’s bedside manner was incredibly dismissive. …
These folks are the sweetest animal lovers and they are the only people I trust with my furry babies! We are always treated with patience and respect and walked through every part of the process.
To all the Bushwick teem your are the best thank you again for take good care of my bird coco she love you all thank you

I rescued a kitten and they helped me so much over the phone and in person! Made me and the baby comfortable and were so sweet and helpful! Definitely recommend for everyone especially for people like me who are first time pet owners and first time vet visit !!! A great experience and wonderful staff & doctor 🐾🤞🏼 …

I’ve been taking my dog here since I got him about a year and a half ago, and they’ve been so lovely! I found out he had heart worm when I adopted him, and it was overwhelming, but the staff at Bushwick Veterinary Clinic helped me …
A typical vet center

I’ve always faced an extensive wait here. On top of that, nobody seems to bother to read up on your pet before seeing them. I’m currently dealing with enormous medical bills from a different hospital because of the poor handling of my dog …
Very great service, spoke with via the phone and got some good information from them that’ll help my travels with my new puppy.

The rabbit doctor took excellent care of my bunnies, providing them with expert treatment and giving amazing care tips to help them get along!!! It was obvious that he truly cared about them personally and ensured that they’re in perfect health!!!!!
